content.text: The billing question multi-step form (category → account picker → details → review) has no Playwright coverage and has regressed twice in the last quarter on step validation.

Add a Playwright spec that walks a happy path for category=invoice_discrepancy, asserts step guards when required fields are empty, submits successfully against mocked billing APIs, and checks the confirmation screen shows the new ticket key. Wire it into CI's support-portal project. Done when the spec is green in CI three consecutive main builds.

description_text:
The billing question multi-step form (category → account picker → details → review) has no Playwright coverage and has regressed twice in the last quarter on step validation.
Add a Playwright spec that walks a happy path for category=invoice_discrepancy, asserts step guards when required fields are empty, submits successfully against mocked billing APIs, and checks the confirmation screen shows the new ticket key. Wire it into CI's support-portal project. Done when the spec is green in CI three consecutive main builds.
